newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares end firm, continuing recovery.
newsitem.headline: German shares end firm, continuing recovery.

text.p: 1245 GMT - German shares end bourse trade firm, continue to build on recovery started on Monday. Wall Street's rebound, stable dollar and steady Bunds buoying market but DAX failed to regain key 2,900 level, despite near miss in pre-bourse.
* DAX index ends up 33.76 points at 2,891.00, just off session high of 2,893.30 points.
* DTB December DAX futures up 19.5 points at 2,888.5.
* Hoechst shares jump to record high after says to merge speciality chemicals with Clariant AG.
* Other chemical stocks also strongly ahead.
* MAN AG down after says could cut dividend.
